cases.name: reactions to missing messages and notices targeting deleted topics do not block later deliveries
WhatsApp reactions appear natively as the reactor’s available member bot without a reply notice
removing one member’s reaction clears only that bot’s reaction
Bifrost shows the latest unbound reaction and preserves remaining reactors when one removes theirs
full OpenWA reaction snapshots and LID aliases reconstruct every actor and remove missing reactions
private message IDs remain scoped to their original bot, regardless of who reacted in WhatsApp
split messages react on the attachment once and skip Telegram copies already cleared
a member bot absent from the group falls back to Bifrost
unavailable emoji clears a stale native reaction and uses one attributed fallback in the same topic
a rate-limited fallback notice is not lost when the original reaction event retries
ambiguous native updates safely retry without uncertain outgoing-send effects
Telegram-owner reactions echoing from WhatsApp do not add duplicate bot reactions or loop back
later repeats of a reaction already represented by the Telegram owner remain suppressed
WhatsApp heart variations normalize to Telegram emoji and do not create a second reaction
unsupported Telegram custom reactions do not clear an existing WhatsApp reaction
Bifrost maps laughing reactions on owner messages, deduplicates equivalent changes and clears on removal
equivalent reactions work through member bots and private copies without altering supported emoji
a refused equivalent and an unsupported unmapped emoji both keep the original in text fallbacks
Telegram-owner reaction echoes stay suppressed after adding equivalent rendering
Telegram custom reactions forward their Unicode equivalent and cache it without converting it to Telegram approximations
member DM reactions are admitted with bot-scoped mappings while group duplicates are ignored
adding a custom reaction beside an existing reaction forwards the new one; removal keeps the remaining one
unresolvable custom reactions produce a temporary independent notice without clearing WhatsApp or blocking a chat
a member unable to access another bot’s message falls back to Bifrost and cached refusals do not suppress that fallback
old definitive reaction refusals expire so corrected permissions can recover
custom-emoji resolution and outbound payload stay frozen across a known send retry
a deleted owner message gets Delete/Keep without overwriting or deleting its Telegram content
Keep removes the fallback notice and preserves the original, including after late edits/history
own phone-originated messages get inline choices; Keep and expiration remove only the buttons
Delete removes every text/media part in the chosen destination while preserving other copies and mappings
other people’s deleted text/media copies are removed automatically without a replacement or choices
duplicate events and conflicting clicks cannot reopen or reverse a completed choice
choices validate owner, bot, destination, message, session and expiry before changing content
expiration defaults to keeping the message and never deletes the original
member-bot private copies keep their bot-scoped identity even when Telegram message IDs overlap
a Telegram deletion refusal preserves the remaining copy and produces no destructive content replacement
an ambiguous keyboard update safely retries without pausing as an uncertain send
saved WhatsApp phone events identify the owner for messages predating the fromMe metadata
fallback prompt expiration keeps the owner’s original message
a timed-out automatic deletion retries safely without an uncertain message send
a timed-out callback acknowledgement retries without blocking the conversation as uncertain
edits of Telegram copies explicitly cleared from the archive do not recreate them
member-bot edits do not restore a sender header; master edit fallback remains attributed
private member-bot messages and edit fallbacks stay nameless in the correct bot DM
out-of-order WhatsApp revocation uses revokedId and prevents history resurrection
child-bot group callbacks remain actionable while its ordinary group updates are ignored
phone-originated private messages and edits never link You to the conversation partner
history metadata survives formatted message edits and captions do not contain raw HTML
candidate KEEP-001 characterizes mute then keep routing in a mirror without choosing a correction
candidate EDIT-001 characterizes the first edited text part applied to every split copy
candidate CALLBACK-001 characterizes retained generic actions in a stale different destination
poll selections toggle single and multiple choices with independently keyed effects
an owner poll_answer is admitted and completed without inventing WhatsApp forwarding
late edits override original text while revoked copies and outbound edit echoes remain suppressed
